gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier for each Spragueia dama record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the GBIF dataset containing Spragueia dama occurrence records.

species.description: Species name for all records, consistently Spragueia dama.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet field is empty for all records.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at the reported locations.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is unavailable for all records.

taxonKey.description: Uniform GBIF taxon identifier for Spragueia dama records.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for each Spragueia dama occurrence record.

basisOfRecord.description: Record type, uniformly classified as human observation for all entries.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying data source, consistently iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: All records are classified under the observation collection type.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of observers who identified the Spragueia dama occurrence records.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record, ranging from 2014 to 2026.

license.description: License specifies the Creative Commons usage terms for each occurrence record.

rightsHolder.description: Individuals or organizations credited for providing each Spragueia dama occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Spragueia dama occurrence.

typeStatus.description: typeStatus field is missing for all records.
